name: react-component-library
description: Single source of truth for the react-component-library CLI command surface. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1; cross-validated against each domain's Connect-RPC proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest. ThemesService and DepsService are intentionally not covered (consumed by UI + adoption-validation only; no CLI surface today).

exceptions.reason: The command owns a filesystem-backed preview-store plan and delegates every package mutation to scenario-dependency-analyzer rather than a Connect RPC.

omitted.reason: Internal/UI-only surface. DepsService is consumed by the UI and the adoption-validation flow, not by the CLI. No deps CLI domain exists (cli/domains has only adoptions, components, preview, versions); the endpoint is intentionally omitted from CLI coverage, and promoting it would require authoring a net-new deps CLI domain + handlers, not wiring an existing hand-appended command. Documented intent in this manifest's description.

Internal/UI-only surface. Consumed by the UI adoption modal's deps-validation step, not the CLI. No deps CLI domain exists; promotion would require net-new handlers rather than wiring an existing command. Documented intent in this manifest's description.

Internal/UI-only surface. ThemesService powers the UI theme picker; no themes CLI domain exists. The endpoint is intentionally omitted from CLI coverage; promotion would require a net-new themes CLI domain + handlers. Documented intent in this manifest's description.

Internal/UI-only surface. UI-only theme retrieval; no themes CLI domain exists. Promotion would require net-new handlers rather than wiring an existing command. Documented intent in this manifest's description.

Internal/UI-only surface. UI resolves a target scenario's DESIGN.md theme via this RPC; no themes CLI domain exists. Promotion would require net-new handlers. Documented intent in this manifest's description.
